definitions.explanation: An accident involving a collision between vehicles, or between a vehicle and an object or person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{衝突事故|しょうとつじこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: A collision accident occurred on the highway.

examples.japanese: {衝突事故|しょうとつじこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}ばれた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: Three people were taken to the hospital after the collision.

examples.japanese: ⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}え→見える：01165_mieru⟧ず、⟦{多重|たじゅう}→多重：19772_tajuu⟧{衝突事故|しょうとつじこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: Visibility was poor due to fog, and a multi-vehicle collision occurred.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{衝突|しょうとつ}→衝突：03235_shoutotsu⟧ (collision/crash) and ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ (accident). Frequently used in news reports about traffic accidents. While ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ alone can mean any kind of accident, {衝突事故|しょうとつじこ} specifies that a collision was involved.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {衝突事故|しょうとつじこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧ — a collision occurs
- {衝突事故|しょうとつじこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ — to cause a collision
- ⟦{多重|たじゅう}→多重：19772_tajuu⟧{衝突事故|しょうとつじこ} — multi-vehicle collision; pileup
- ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧{衝突事故|しょうとつじこ} — head-on collision

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{交通事故|こうつうじこ}→交通事故：21255_koutsuujiko⟧ — traffic accident (broader; includes any type of traffic accident)
- ⟦{追突事故|ついとつじこ}→追突事故：24064_tsuitotsujiko⟧ — rear-end collision
- ⟦{接触事故|せっしょくじこ}→接触事故：24272_sesshokujiko⟧ — minor collision/fender bender (less severe than a full collision)
